title: Cross-Domain Transfer of Misalignment: Does Insecure Code Generalize More Than Other Deceptive Tasks?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Answers whether the emergent misalignment threat is narrow or broad across task types. This directly informs which fine-tuning use cases practitioners should scrutinize most carefully.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires constructing multiple deceptive fine-tuning datasets (misleading reviews, citation fabrication, deceptive sales) in addition to the existing insecure-code one. Dataset creation for each domain is non-trivial for beginners. Multiple fine-tuning runs compound compute needs.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Comparing across 4+ deceptive task types, each requiring its own dataset and fine-tuning run, is broad. Even scoped to 2 domains, the dataset construction plus training plus evaluation is substantial for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
